mnMultiDelivery.heading: Deliveries
mnMultiDelivery.intro: Have your order delivered in several parts – to different addresses or as soon as items are ready.

strategyHints.manual: Move items between deliveries and pick an address for each.
strategyHints.availability: In-stock items ship now, the rest as soon as it's available.
strategyHints.warehouse: Each warehouse ships its items separately.
strategyHints.deliveryTime: Items with similar delivery times ship together.

blocked.payment: Several deliveries aren't available with the selected payment method.
blocked.subscription: Subscriptions are delivered in one shipment.

mnMultiDelivery.countryHint: Deliveries can go to any of your addresses in %country%. Taxes are calculated for one country per order.

separate.hint: Deliveries can go to any of your addresses. A delivery to another country than %country% is placed as a separate order, with that country's taxes and shipping costs, its own confirmation and its own invoice.
separate.paymentHint: Deliveries can go to your addresses in %country%. To send a delivery to another country, choose a payment method without online payment, such as invoice or prepayment – it is then placed as a separate order.
separate.placedHeading: Your purchase was placed as %count% orders
separate.placedText: Your deliveries were placed as separate orders, each with its own confirmation and invoice.
separate.allHint: Deliveries can go to any of your addresses. Every additional delivery is placed as a separate order, with its own confirmation and invoice; deliveries to another country than %country% get that country's taxes and shipping costs.

error.MN_MULTI_DELIVERY__SEPARATE_ORDER_PAYMEN: Deliveries to other countries are placed as separate orders. That isn't possible with the selected payment method – please choose invoice or prepayment, or send all deliveries within one country.
error.MN_MULTI_DELIVERY__SEPARATE_ORDER_INVALI: One of the separate orders for your deliveries can't be placed. Please check that delivery's address and shipping method.
